text: Carpentry involves constructing diverse items, including doors, cabinets, and household furniture. The workflow initiates with sawing, where a metal blade cuts wood or sheet metal into specific dimensions. Following the cut, sanding employs a block or steel plate to eliminate rough surfaces. Painting then applies the final aesthetic layer. Once a component reaches completion, sawing may begin again to refine another section, repeating this cycle until the project finishes. This trade spans small objects and massive constructions like bridges and buildings.
